# Notebook Kit Semantics

Fixture for notebook-kit runtime shapes. Authored locally; built with `KEEP_JS=1` so `js` cells stay notebook-kit 2.0 (multi-output) and `ojs` cells stay Observable 1.0.

Every cell here exists to make one runtime shape observable. Do not "tidy" it.

## 2.0 native (js): multi-output

`transpile.ts:103` derives `outputs` from top-level declarations, so each of these becomes a `cell N` holder plus one `(exports) => exports[o]` projection per name.

## 1.0 (ojs)

Single-output path: `output` is set, `outputs` is undefined. autoview and automutable derive the extra variables.

## Cross-dialect wiring

A projection from a js cell must be an ordinary variable, consumable from ojs and vice versa.

## Multi-import: two import cells, one source module

This is the case today's `cellMap` collapses: it keys by source module, so both cells land in one bucket and the second is lost. They must recover as two distinct cells.
